item.text: Clone probes identify the blue object as the avatar: actions 3 and 4 move it left and right. Level 3 adds purple tiles that block movement when solid; clicking toggles them to a passable outline. I’ll test how they affect ascent before extending the existing shaft leg.

The extended shaft leg cleared level 3 on a clone in 34 actions. It closes purple tiles beneath lethal ceilings to create safe supports, then opens passages to continue upward. The exit raised the reward to 3. I’ll now wire that leg into the player and verify it through the harness.
